children: Oct 15 (Reuters) - Canadian factory sales grew by 1.5% in August from July on higher sales of primary metals, as well as chemicals, Statistics Canada said on Thursday.   Excluding motor vehicles and parts, manufacturing sales were up 2.1%.

Month/month change (%)                                             Aug   Jul(rev)  Jul(prev)  Sales                +1.5     -0.3      -0.4Sales ex-autos       +2.1     -0.4      -0.5Inventories          +0.2     +0.4      +0.3Unfilled orders       0.0     +1.3      +1.9New orders           -0.7     -0.5      +0.7                                           Aug   Jul(rev)  Jul(prev) Inv/sales ratio      1.60     1.62      1.62

NOTE: All figures are seasonally adjusted. Analysts surveyed by Reuters forecast manufacturing sales to increase 1.1% in August from July.   (Reporting by Dale Smith; editing by Promit Mukherjee) ((promit.mukherjee@tr.com))
